meta.title: Engineering system connection graph
meta.description: A traceable map from projects to engineering capabilities to concrete evidence.

nodes.label: Engineering Core
nodes.description: Shared loop across the portfolio: build, test, stress, measure, explain, improve.

nodes.label: Reliable ML
nodes.description: Measure model behavior under assumptions, stress, and distribution change instead of relying on a single headline metric.

nodes.label: Reproducibility
nodes.description: Explicit seeds, controlled configuration, repeatable experiments, and inspectable artifacts.

nodes.label: Verification & CI
nodes.description: Tests, builds, linting, release gates, and automated verification as part of engineering rather than cleanup.

nodes.label: Evidence & Reporting
nodes.description: Turn system behavior into reports, metrics, visualizations, and artifacts that can be inspected later.

nodes.label: Distribution Shift
nodes.description: Controlled covariate, label, and concept changes for probing how ML behavior degrades away from IID conditions.

nodes.label: Backend Systems
nodes.description: APIs, persistence, domain logic, and data movement behind user-facing products.

nodes.label: State & Data Integrity
nodes.description: Model state carefully, preserve invariants, migrate schemas deliberately, and keep data usable under real product workflows.

nodes.label: Product Engineering
nodes.description: Build complete user workflows rather than isolated demos: packaging, release, UX, persistence, and maintainability.

nodes.label: Retrieval & Ranking
nodes.description: Ingest, classify, score, search, cluster, and resurface information based on usefulness.

nodes.label: Explainable Decisions
nodes.description: Expose why a system classified, scored, or surfaced something instead of returning opaque output.

nodes.label: Security ML
nodes.description: Apply representation learning and anomaly detection to security-oriented event and identity-compromise signals.

nodes.label: Hybrid ML Pipelines
nodes.description: Combine learned representations with classical models and score fusion instead of forcing one model to do everything.

nodes.label: ConformalGuard
nodes.description: CPU-friendly toolkit for stress-testing conformal classification under IID, covariate, label, and concept shift.

nodes.label: RetailPilot
nodes.description: Offline-first Android POS and inventory system with modular architecture, Room persistence, migrations, and release workflows.

nodes.label: Social Saver
nodes.description: Cognitive layer for ingesting, classifying, scoring, searching, clustering, and resurfacing saved information.

nodes.label: Anomaly Detection
nodes.description: Hybrid security anomaly pipeline using Transformer-VAE representations, classical outlier detectors, and attention-based score fusion.

nodes.label: Controlled shift families
nodes.description: IID reference plus covariate, label, and concept shift experiments with explicit severity/configuration.

nodes.label: IID-relative degradation
nodes.description: Normalized degradation analysis compares shifted accuracy, F1, coverage, coverage gap, set size, and empty-set rate against IID.

nodes.label: Multi-dataset suite
nodes.description: Network-free robustness suite runs built-in datasets and emits per-dataset plus aggregate scorecards.

nodes.label: CLI + Python API + report
nodes.description: High-level API and CLI produce summary/degradation data plus static HTML and plot artifacts.

nodes.label: Regression test surface
nodes.description: Tests cover the experiment, degradation, plotting, reporting, and public API surface; live repository status is shown separately.

nodes.label: Offline-first Room state
nodes.description: Core retail workflows stay usable without a network connection through local Room persistence.

nodes.label: Inventory & money invariants
nodes.description: Inventory movements, stock batches, insufficient-stock validation, integer minor-unit money storage, and versioned migrations.

nodes.label: Modular Android architecture
nodes.description: Responsibilities are separated across app, core, feature:store, and feature:reports modules.

nodes.label: Build / test / lint / release
nodes.description: GitHub Actions mirrors build, unit-test, and lint checks, with a release workflow that validates version and publishes APK/checksum artifacts.

nodes.label: FastAPI ingestion pipeline
nodes.description: Incoming messages are routed through a FastAPI backend into processing and storage.

nodes.label: Explainable scoring
nodes.description: Classification and importance scoring expose category and keyword-based reasoning rather than only a final score.

nodes.label: Search, clusters, resurfacing
nodes.description: Stored information can be searched, grouped by theme, ranked, and resurfaced as a high-signal memory aid.

nodes.label: Transformer-VAE representation
nodes.description: A Patch-Transformer VAE maps mixed high-dimensional data into a compact latent representation.

nodes.label: Unsupervised detector ensemble
nodes.description: Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, and Local Outlier Factor generate independent anomaly signals on the latent space.

nodes.label: Attention score fusion
nodes.description: A PyTorch attention layer learns how to combine detector scores into a final prediction.
